metadata.question: Does the extent of burn scars in the Flint Hills region of eastern Kansas increase on April 8, 2023, compared to March 19, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-2 for burn scar detection with its 10m resolution - Date 1: March 19, 2023 - Date 2: April 8, 2023 - Location: Flint Hills region of eastern Kansas (approximate center: 38.5°N, -96.5°W) - Need images close to these specific dates 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds to get clean data - Use NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) or a burn-related index to detect burn scars - NBR = (NIR - SWIR) / (NIR + SWIR), where lower values indicate burned areas - Or use simple threshold on SWIR bands 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Calculate total area of burn scars for each date - Valid Zero: If calculations succeed but burn area is 0 or minimal - C3: If results are None/NaN or invalid - Compare: If April 8 > March 19, answer A; otherwise B - Check for C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels after masking) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const flintHills = ee.Geometry.Point([-96.5, 38.5]).buffer(50000); // 50km radius around Flint Hills const date1 = '2023-03-19'; const date2 = '2023-04-08'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Get images for March 19 const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(flintHills) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(3, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`March 19 Images: ${size1}`); if (size1 === 0) { console.log("No data for March 19, 2023."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Get images for April 8 const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(flintHills) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(3, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 8 Images: ${size2}`); if (size2 === 0) { console.log("No data for April 8, 2023."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate NBR and detect burns function calculateNBR(image) { const nir = image.select('B8'); const swir = image.select('B12'); const nbr = nir.subtract(swir).divide(nir.add(swir)).rename('NBR'); return image.addBands(nbr); } const img1 = col1.map(calculateNBR).median(); const img2 = col2.map(calculateNBR).median(); // Burn scars typically have NBR < 0.1 (lower values indicate recent burns) const burnThreshold = 0.1; const burns1 = img1.select('NBR').lt(burnThreshold); const burns2 = img2.select('NBR').lt(burnThreshold); // 4. Calculate burn scar areas const count1 = await burns1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: flintHills, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); const count2 = await burns2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: flintHills, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); console.log(`March 19 burn pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`April 8 burn pixels: ${count2}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (count1 === null || count2 === null || isNaN(count1) || isNaN(count2)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (count1 === 0 && count2 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } console.log(`Burn extent change: ${((count2 - count1) / Math.max(count1, 1) * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); if (count2 > count1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
